title: Advancing Common Good Human Resource Management: Empowering HR Managers and Line Managers Working with Employees with Disability
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University), Monash University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Advancing Common Good Human Resource Management: Empowering HR Managers and Line Managers Working with Employees with Disability
detail.abstract: Disability impacts individuals in the workplace and society, which calls for stronger organizational and human resource management (HRM) commitment to workers with a disability. From the perspectives of human resource (HR) managers and line managers, this study examines the role of common good human resource management (CGHRM) and workers with a disability. CGHRM is critical to fostering employee attitudes and behaviors required for organizations to meet the challenges in an increasingly complex environment. We argue that a combination of resource-based theory (RBT) (i.e., internal resources and capabilities) and common good human resource management (CGHRM) approaches (i.e., wellbeing over financial gain) address the health and wellbeing of workers with a disability. Drawing on the perspectives of HR managers and line managers through three vignettes, we illustrate the process through which common good values (i.e., reciprocity, dignity and solidarity) are translated into organizational common good goals and subsequently into CGHRM practices. We found when there is a strong relationship between RBT and CGHRM important insights can better support HR managers to address the mental health and wellbeing challenges of workers with a disability at the workplace. Our study contributes to the RBT, CGHRM and disability literature by expanding conceptual transparency about how common good values can be practiced by HR managers and line managers and support vulnerable worker cohorts such as those with a disability. It provides practical implications for organizations seeking to improve the health and wellbeing of vulnerable workers through inclusive HRM practices and stakeholder engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究从HR经理和直线经理的视角，探讨共同利益人力资源管理(CGHRM)如何通过结合资源基础理论(RBT)来支持残疾员工的健康福祉。研究发现，当RBT与CGHRM强关联时，能更好地帮助HR经理应对职场中残疾员工的心理健康挑战。
AI.research_question: 共同利益人力资源管理(CGHRM)如何支持职场中残疾员工的健康与福祉？
AI.motivation: 残疾对个人在职场和社会中产生影响，需要组织和人力资源管理对残疾员工做出更强承诺。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础理论(RBT)和共同利益人力资源管理(CGHRM)框架
AI.method: 通过三个情境案例，收集HR经理和直线经理的视角数据
AI.findings: 当RBT与CGHRM建立强关联时，能为HR经理提供重要见解，更好地支持残疾员工的心理健康和福祉挑战
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了RBT、CGHRM和残疾文献，澄清了共同利益价值观如何被HR经理和直线经理实践的概念透明度
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织通过包容性HRM实践和利益相关者参与来改善弱势员工健康福祉提供实践启示

title: From Decline to Recovery? A Causal Analysis of Incheon’s Comprehensive Fertility Incentive Program

detail.title: From Decline to Recovery? A Causal Analysis of Incheon’s Comprehensive Fertility Incentive Program
detail.abstract: South Korea has grappled with persistently low fertility rates despite two decades of government intervention, including the implementation of the Basic Plan for Low Fertility and Aging Society. Existing childbirth incentive policies have shown limited effectiveness, prompting the need for more substantial and sustained support measures. This study investigates the causal impact of Incheon Metropolitan City’s “100 Million+ i-Dream" policy—launched in 2024 and offering up to 100 million KRW per child until age 18—on fertility rates. Using a Synthetic Differencein-Differences (SDID) methodology, we analyze birth trends across 16 administrative districts from 2000 to 2024, controlling for various confounding factors. Our findings indicate that the policy led to a 5% increase in the total fertility rate and an 8% increase in the number of births in 2024. While these early  results are promising, the full effects may not yet be observable due to the short post-implementation window. Nevertheless, the study provides valuable evidence suggesting that comprehensive, long-term financial support can positively influence fertility decisions. These insights offer meaningful guidance for future policy design aimed at addressing Korea’s demographic challenges.

AI.tldr: 韩国仁川市2024年推出的"1亿+ i-Dream"政策（为每个孩子提供最高1亿韩元直至18岁）使总和生育率提高5%，出生人数增加8%，表明全面长期财政支持能有效提升生育率。
AI.research_question: 仁川市"1亿+ i-Dream"政策对生育率的因果影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管韩国实施低生育率与老龄化社会基本计划已20年，现有生育激励政策效果有限，需要更实质性和持续的支持措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生育决策理论，强调经济激励对生育行为的影响。
AI.method: 使用合成双重差分法（SDID），分析2000-2024年16个行政区的生育趋势，控制各种混杂因素。
AI.findings: 政策导致2024年总和生育率提高5%，出生人数增加8%。早期结果积极，但完整效果可能因实施时间短尚未完全显现。
AI.theory_contributions: 为全面长期财政支持对生育决策的积极影响提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来应对韩国人口挑战的政策设计提供有价值的指导，表明大规模长期经济支持是有效的生育激励措施。

title: A machine learning framework bridging heavy metal contamination and human health risks in agricultural soils of the Yangtze River Delta (2001–2030)
affiliations: Zhejiang Gongshang University, Zhejiang Gongshang University, Shanghai Academy of Environmental Sciences, Shanghai Academy of Environmental Sciences, Zhejiang Gongshang University, Zhejiang Gongshang University (ZJGSU) - College of Environmental Science and Engineering, Zhejiang Gongshang University, Zhejiang Gongshang University, Zhejiang Gongshang University (ZJGSU) and Zhejiang University

detail.title: A machine learning framework bridging heavy metal contamination and human health risks in agricultural soils of the Yangtze River Delta (2001–2030)
detail.abstract: Existing studies face limitations in conducting dynamic risk assessments due to complex pollution sources and insufficient long-term monitoring data of heavy metal (HM) pollution in agricultural soils. Focusing on the Yangtze River Delta (YRD), this study developed an integrated assessment framework combining multi-source environmental data and machine learning (ML) approaches to evaluate the spatiotemporal evolution and health risks of eight HMs over a 20-year period (2001–2020). Among the HMs studied, cadmium (Cd) emerged as a primary pollutant, with soil concentrations showing a marked increase from 0.16 mg/kg (2001–2005) to 0.28 mg/kg (2016–2020). Feature importance analysis identified industrial (23.39%), transportation (21.08%), and agricultural activities (19.79%) as main contributors to soil Cd accumulation. By constructing and comparing nine ML models, we determined that an optimized extreme gradient boosting (XGB) model provided the best predictive performance (R2 = 0.70) of Cd concentration. It successfully predicted the soil Cd concentrations in 2024, which aligned well with subsequent field measurements (R2 = 0.89). A health risk assessment integrating the XGB model with Monte Carlo simulation showed the increasing carcinogenic risk of Cd for children over the next five years, with the dominant risk source shifting from transportation (30.6%) to agricultural activities (38.5%). Path analysis confirmed the significant and direct effects of transportation (path coefficient = 0.55) and agricultural sources (path coefficient = 0.26) on Cd contamination. The established framework provides an effective methodology for the dynamic assessment and proactive management of soil HM pollution in rapidly developing regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个结合多源环境数据和机器学习方法的综合评估框架，用于评估长江三角洲地区2001-2020年间8种重金属的时空演变和健康风险。研究发现镉是主要污染物，浓度显著增加，工业、交通和农业活动是主要贡献源。优化的XGBoost模型预测性能最佳，健康风险评估显示未来五年儿童致癌风险增加。
AI.research_question: 如何有效评估长江三角洲地区重金属污染的时空演变和健康风险？
AI.motivation: 现有研究因污染源复杂和长期监测数据不足，在动态风险评估方面存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合评估框架、机器学习预测模型、健康风险评估理论
AI.method: 结合多源环境数据和机器学习方法，构建并比较9个ML模型，使用优化的XGBoost模型进行预测，结合蒙特卡洛模拟进行健康风险评估
AI.findings: 镉是主要污染物，浓度从0.16 mg/kg增加到0.28 mg/kg；工业(23.39%)、交通(21.08%)和农业活动(19.79%)是主要贡献源；XGBoost模型预测性能最佳(R2=0.70)；儿童致癌风险增加，风险源从交通(30.6%)转向农业活动(38.5%)
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了动态评估重金属污染的综合框架，验证了机器学习在环境风险评估中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为快速发展地区土壤重金属污染的动态评估和主动管理提供了有效方法学

title: The Dark-Side Effect of Family Management on Corporate Charitable Donations in Emerging Markets: Evidence from China
affiliations: Zhejiang University of Technology and University of Dayton

detail.title: The Dark-Side Effect of Family Management on Corporate Charitable Donations in Emerging Markets: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: While family firms are often characterized as philanthropic stewards, the existing literature overlooks a “dark side” wherein the pursuit of restricted socio-emotional wealth (SEW) can inhibit charitable giving. This study posits that a high degree of family management, indicative of a restricted SEW focus, reduces both the willingness and ability to allocate resources to non-family stakeholders. Through an analysis of 278 privately-owned Chinese family firms, we find that family management negatively impacts a firm’s charitable donations. This effect is particularly pronounced in larger firms, where increased administrative complexity exacerbates managerial limitations, and in competitive environments marked by unfair competition, which heightens risk aversion. By identifying the distinct role of management in activating the dark side of SEW and delineating key boundary conditions, our study contributes to a more nuanced understanding of corporate philanthropy in family businesses.

AI.tldr: 家族企业管理程度越高，慈善捐赠越少，特别是在大型企业和竞争激烈环境中更明显
AI.research_question: 家族企业管理如何影响企业的慈善捐赠行为？
AI.motivation: 现有文献忽视了家族企业追求受限社会情感财富的"阴暗面"，这种追求可能抑制慈善捐赠
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会情感财富理论，特别是受限SEW焦点
AI.method: 对278家中国私营家族企业进行分析
AI.findings: 家族管理对企业慈善捐赠产生负面影响；这种效应在大型企业和竞争激烈环境中更为显著
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了管理在激活SEW阴暗面中的独特作用，并界定了关键边界条件
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解家族企业慈善捐赠提供了更细致的视角

title: Late-career nurses matter: A Discrete Choice Experiment to elicit preferences to delay retirement
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Portsmouth, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Late-career nurses matter: A Discrete Choice Experiment to elicit preferences to delay retirement
detail.abstract: Background: In England, disproportionate numbers of registered nurses leave the National Health Service (NHS) early as they approach retirement age. Extending the working lives of late-career nurses would retain valuable experience. Research is needed to understand the job preferences of late-career NHS nurses to develop tailored retention policies.Aims: To identify the job characteristics influencing late-career NHS nurses’ retirement decisions and estimate trade-offs between these job characteristics using a Discrete Choice Experiment (DCE).Design: A DCE is a survey technique enabling preferences to be elicited by presenting alternative job package options. Nurses then choose their preferred job package.Methods: Following established practice, we employed both qualitative (i.e., literature review, focus groups, discussions with academic experts and stakeholders, including retention leaders) and quantitative methods to identify and select the job attributes. The DCE – included as part of a larger questionnaire – included eight job attributes. A ‘year’ characteristic was included to estimate ‘willingness to delay’ retirement. The DCE was administered through online surveys and distributed by the Nursing and Midwifery Council.Results: 6,888 late-career nurses responded to the DCE. We specified a Random Effect Probit regression model to estimate the preferences for delaying retirement among late-career NHS nurses. Late-career NHS nurses value teams with good collaboration; this ranked highest (Relative Importance RI: 19.6%). The number of extra years beyond nurses’ intended retirement age was the second most important job characteristic (RI: 18.8%), followed by recognition (RI:13.7%) and low work pressure (RI: 13.1%). If all job characteristics were at the best levels, late-career NHS nurses would be willing to delay retirement by 2.7 years beyond their intended retirement age.Conclusion: Good teamwork and collaboration, recognition and low work pressure are key for late-career NHS nurses when considering retirement. Healthcare organisations should provide a workplace culture that reflects these preferred job characteristics to retain their current workforce.Registration details: Registration on OSF: http://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/RDN9G and protocol published in BMJ Open: https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjopen-2023-075066

AI.tldr: 本文通过离散选择实验研究了英国NHS晚期职业护士的工作偏好，发现良好的团队合作、认可度和低工作压力是影响他们延迟退休决策的关键因素。如果所有工作特征都处于最佳水平，护士愿意平均延迟退休2.7年。
AI.research_question: 哪些工作特征影响英国NHS晚期职业护士的退休决策？这些工作特征之间的权衡关系如何？
AI.motivation: 英国NHS中大量注册护士在接近退休年龄时提前离职，延长晚期职业护士的工作年限可以保留宝贵经验，需要了解他们的工作偏好以制定针对性的留任政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散选择实验理论，通过呈现不同工作组合选项来引出偏好，使用随机效应Probit回归模型估计偏好。
AI.method: 采用定性和定量相结合的方法识别工作属性，包括文献回顾、焦点小组、专家讨论等。离散选择实验包含8个工作属性，通过在线调查收集了6,888名晚期职业护士的数据。
AI.findings: 晚期职业护士最看重良好的团队合作（相对重要性19.6%），其次是延迟退休年限（18.8%）、认可度（13.7%）和低工作压力（13.1%）。如果所有工作特征都处于最佳水平，护士愿意平均延迟退休2.7年。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解医疗工作者退休决策提供了实证证据，扩展了离散选择实验在人力资源管理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗组织制定护士留任政策提供了具体指导，建议重点关注团队合作文化、员工认可和工作压力管理。
